result.summary: Found 2 issues: a data/content bug showing 'NaN' delivery price and a layout issue with content being cut off at the screen edge.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers card shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price, indicating a calculation or data-binding error
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery fee calculation logic to handle missing or invalid numeric values and display a proper price or 'Free'

issues.description: The third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccolo) in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll/card width so cards are either fully visible or clearly indicate scrollability with partial preview intentionally styled

issues.description: Inconsistent heart/favorite icon styling between the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card (white icon on transparent circle) and the pizza card (dark circle background)
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon button style across all restaurant cards for visual consistency
